newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers edge up, demand seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers edge up, demand seen rising.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged up on Monday amid signs that demand is rising, brokers said.
They said 380 cSt fuel was priced at $85/86 a tonne, with 180 cSt at $91/92, up a couple of dollars from Friday. Antwerp prices were at about the same level.
One broker said demand at 15,000 tonnes was average but seemed set to increase. "There are some big volume enquiries around and some new ones are trickling in," he added.
Mediterranean prices were little changed except in Piraeus were they were firmer.
Piraeus 380 cSt rose to $90/91 from $86/88 while 180 cSt increased to $96/97 from $91/94.
In the Gulf, Fujairah prices were little changed at $97 and $103 respectively.
